prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较供应商报价、交期和质保，并记录评审意见及无效投标结果。","reading":"读者先按行识别供应商，再横向比较报价、交期和质保；甲、乙共享的评审意见跨两行，丙的无效投标说明横跨三个指标列。","groups":["报价、交期、质保是并列的采购比较指标，应保持清晰的列间节奏。","供应商是行标识；评审意见是解释性文字，与数值指标的阅读方式不同。"],"keep_intact":["报价金额及货币符号，便于准确比较。","供应商名称、交期和质保值尽量保持完整，便于按行扫描。","跨行评审意见和跨列无效投标说明的合并关系。"],"may_wrap":["评审意见可按中文自然换行；其跨两行的高度可吸收部分换行。","无效投标说明可在横跨报价、交期和质保的单元格内自然换行。","空间紧张时，中文表头和供应商名称可以换行，但会降低扫描速度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [67, 86, 52, 52, 102] · table 360×296px · row heights [36, 100, 100, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [67, 86, 59, 45, 102] · table 360×319px · row heights [60, 100, 100, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [67, 86, 55, 48, 101] · table 358×319px · row heights [60, 100, 100, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"表头、供应商名称、金额和质保值均保持完整；共享评审意见的跨行关系和丙公司的跨列说明都清楚。","problems":"两家供应商的交期都拆成数字与“天”两行，削弱了三个指标横向比较时的行内节奏；评审意见也较窄，换行频繁。","cause":"交期列52px扣除21px后仅余31px，容不下38px的交期值；评审意见列102px仅余81px文本宽度。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"交期值保持单行，金额和供应商名称完整，跨行及跨列关系清楚。","problems":"质保表头及其数值都断成两行，表头因此增高，质保列也显得局促，与相邻指标列的节奏失衡。","cause":"质保列45px扣除21px后仅余24px，小于31px的表头宽度；多给交期列的宽度来自质保列。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"供应商名称和金额完整，合并单元格关系仍然清楚。","problems":"交期值和质保表头、数值均换行，同时损害数据行扫描和表头层级；相比r1A和r1B没有明显收益。","cause":"交期列55px仅余34px，容不下38px的值；质保列48px仅余27px，容不下31px的表头。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"指标完整","widths":[60,86,59,52,102],"change":"将供应商列缩至60px，腾出7px给交期列；供应商名称、金额、交期及质保仍各有足够宽度保持单行，评审意见维持102px。"},{"name":"意见优先","widths":[60,86,59,52,102],"change":"以供应商列的单行所需宽度为下限，确保三项指标完整，同时把剩余102px留给共享评审意见。"},{"name":"交期换行换意见宽度","widths":[60,86,52,52,109],"change":"保留r1A的交期换行，用缩窄供应商列腾出的7px加宽评审意见；用于比较更宽的说明文字是否足以补偿交期拆行。"}]}
